arguments.summary: The p99 latency spike was due to the connection pool exhaustion in pgbouncer. The connection pool was exhausted, leading to a worker throughput of 0. Restarting pgbouncer in the prod namespace cleared the pool. The failed jobs backlog in the jobs database contains 1388 failed entries, and 47 of them are malformed. Pgbouncer logs will be reviewed for more details on the failures. Further investigation is needed to determine the cause of the failures.
